verdict.rationale: Warp's own Agent handles onboarding and tax notices and checks in with the user when a decision is theirs. Its event-triggered jobs and automatic multi-state tax registrations suggest the product reacts when new hires or new locations create obligations. None of this is documented as proactive compliance alerting. Webhooks are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. missing for 10: explicit compliance-obligation alerts for new hires and new locations, any law-change monitoring or notification, documentation of alert channels and content, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get proactive alerts when a new hire, location, or law change creates a compliance obligation

citations.quote: Warp Agent takes onboarding, payroll, tax notices, and benefits. It asks when a decision is yours, and records every action it takes.
Jobs that run on a schedule or when something happens. Defaults are on, and you can write your own.
Tax registrations, filings, and payments handled automatically across all 50 states.
